notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give The Great Goblin lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
easyPrerequisites: You control another Goblin, Orc or Army.
description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on another Goblin, Orc or Army you control.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 2 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.
